name: Hexagon 2
description: v1's Hexagon 2: two honeycomb crystals of 240 atoms each (6 up + 6 down quarks and 2 electrons, nuclear charge alternating ±1 around each hexagon) collide head-on at a closing speed of 4, under v1's sine nuclear force (range 500) and Coulomb (k = 1/60), inside a sphere of radius 1e5 that keeps half the normal speed on a bounce. Gravity (G = 1e-3) is negligible here and omitted.
